# Release notes

One file per release of this plugin, named `v<version>.md`.

The `upstream-*.md` files were inherited from the parent project,
[dsh-plugin-message-edit](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit).
They describe its releases, and its version numbers do not line up with this
repository's; the tags pointing at them are named `upstream-*` for the same
reason. They are kept for provenance, not as this plugin's history.
